title: Zesty Shattering Argentinian Beef Skewers
description: A tangy and flavorful Argentinian dish featuring passata and shio-koji-cure, perfect for a monsoon evening, this recipe is gluten-free-friendly and sure to delight your taste buds with its shattering texture and bold flavors.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 200 degrees Celsius.
In a large bowl, whisk together passata, shio-koji, olive oil, garlic, red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper.
Add the beef strips to the bowl and mix until they are well coated with the marinade.
Thread the marinated beef strips onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the beef is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Remove the skewers from the grill and sprinkle with parsley and lemon juice.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
Slice the skewers into bite-sized pieces and serve immediately.
